notes: LastSeenRegistry on Robinhood Chain provides a public wallet do-not-send list, stolen-funds bounties and paid contract audits using signed IdentityMD oracle answers through Intake. The paying wallet resolves through $owner and controls the oracle settings. Constructor arguments set the approved Intake, action, existing payment asset, price and attester; the initial audit surcharge equals the price. The constructor creates its LastSeenQuestions helper internally. This contracts-only launch creates no token and requires no ETH funding or initialization calls.
